# Typing-good-<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>typing good</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Noto+Sans+Khmer:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            --text-main: #ffffff;
            --text-muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
            --text-error: #ff6b7a;
            --accent: #ffd700; 
            --caret-glow: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.6);
            
            --font-ui: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            
            --glass-bg: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.4);
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        }

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            /* THIS LINE LOADS YOUR IMAGE */
            background-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center;
            background-repeat: no-repeat;
            background-attachment: fixed;
            
            color: var(--text-main);
            font-family: var(--font-ui);
            height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Soft cinematic overlay: lets the scenery shine while keeping text readable */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 90% at 50% 45%, rgba(6, 20, 22, 0.12) 0%, rgba(4, 14, 18, 0.38) 65%, rgba(2, 10, 14, 0.62) 100%),
                linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(2, 12, 16, 0.55) 0%, rgba(2, 12, 16, 0.08) 22%, rgba(2, 12, 16, 0.08) 70%, rgba(2, 12, 16, 0.6) 100%);
            backdrop-filter: saturate(130%) contrast(102%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(130%) contrast(102%);
            z-index: -1;
        }

        /* Gentle warm glow drifting across the scene */
        body::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, rgba(255, 244, 214, 0.16), transparent 45%);
            mix-blend-mode: screen;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: -1;
            animation: driftGlow 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes driftGlow {
            0%   { background-position: 0% 0%; opacity: 0.9; }
            100% { background-position: 30% 20%; opacity: 0.5; }
        }

        header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 2rem 3rem;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .logo { 
            display: flex; 
            align-items: center; 
            font-size: 1.8rem; 
            font-weight: 600; 
            letter-spacing: -0.5px; 
            cursor: pointer; 
            color: var(--text-main);
            transition: 0.15s ease;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }
        
        .logo:hover { transform: scale(1.02); }


        main { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 2rem; margin-top: -5vh; z-index: 10; }

        .timer-display {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: 3rem;
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: color 0.3s ease;
            display: none; 
            text-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        }
        .timer-display.active { display: block; }
        .timer-display.warning { color: var(--text-error); }

        .config-bar {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; 
            background: var(--glass-bg); 
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 12px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px); 
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); 
            margin-bottom: 4rem;
            font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.85rem; 
            color: var(--text-muted); 
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .config-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem; }
        .config-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; transition: 0.15s ease; user-select: none; }
        .config-item:hover, .config-item.active { color: var(--text-main); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }
        .config-item.active { color: var(--accent); text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--caret-glow); }
        .divider { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); }

        .typing-container { width: 100%; max-width: 1000px; position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
        .language-indicator { text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; text-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }

        .words-wrapper {
            width: 100%; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.6; 
            color: var(--text-muted);
            user-select: none; word-break: break-word; letter-spacing: 0.5px; position: relative; transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        .words-wrapper.finished { opacity: 0.2; filter: blur(4px); pointer-events: none; }

        .word { display: inline-block; margin-right: 0.6em; position: relative; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; }
        .word.error { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--text-error); }
        .letter { transition: color 0.1s ease; }
        .letter.correct { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.95), 0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,0.75), 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }
        .letter.incorrect { color: #ff3b4e; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255,40,60,0.95), 0 0 16px rgba(255,40,60,0.8), 0 0 30px rgba(255,40,60,0.55); }
        .caret.flash-ok { background-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }
        .caret.flash-bad { background-color: #ff3b4e; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 4px rgba(255,40,60,0.95); }

        .caret {
            position: absolute; width: 3px; height: 1.8rem; background-color: var(--accent); border-radius: 2px; left: 0; top: 0;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--caret-glow); z-index: 10; pointer-events: none; will-change: transform; 
        }

        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--caret-glow); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--caret-glow); }
        }
        .caret.pulse { animation: pulse 1s infinite; }

        .restart-btn {
            margin-top: 4rem; 
            background: var(--glass-bg); 
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            color: var(--text-muted); padding: 14px; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); 
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }
        .restart-btn svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); }
        .restart-btn:hover { color: var(--text-main); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 5px 20px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
        .restart-btn:hover svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }
        .restart-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

        .footer-controls { margin-top: 3rem; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 2rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; opacity: 0.8; transition: 0.3s ease; text-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
        .footer-controls:hover { opacity: 1; }
        .key-hint { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
        .key { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-main); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); }
        
        .bottom-info { position: absolute; bottom: 2rem; right: 3rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.8rem; opacity: 0.6; transition: 0.15s ease; z-index: 10; text-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }
        .bottom-info:hover { opacity: 1; }

        .results-screen {
            position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; z-index: 20;
            animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease forwards;
            background: var(--glass-bg);
            padding: 3rem 4rem;
            border-radius: 24px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }
        @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -40%); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } }

        .results-screen h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 400; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
        .results-stats { display: flex; gap: 4rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; }
        .stat-box { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
        .stat-value { font-size: 4rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); color: var(--accent); line-height: 1; text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--caret-glow); }
        .stat-label { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 0.5rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }
        
        .focus-warning {
            position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.6); padding: 1rem 2rem;
            border-radius: 10px; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); color: var(--text-main); display: none; align-items: center; gap: 10px; cursor: pointer; z-index: 15; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
        }

        .words-wrapper.khmer { font-family: 'Noto Sans Khmer','Khmer OS Battambang','Leelawadee UI','Khmer UI',sans-serif; font-size: 1.9rem; line-height: 2; letter-spacing: 0; }
        .letter.partial { color: var(--accent); }
        .lang-opt { font-family: var(--font-ui), 'Noto Sans Khmer', sans-serif; }
        .hanzi { display: block; text-align: center; font-family: 'Noto Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Heiti SC',sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1.3; text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.65); }
        .words-wrapper.zh { line-height: 1.5; }
        .words-wrapper { overflow: hidden; }
        /* Extra scroll room at the end so even the last lines can scroll up to the top row */
        .words-wrapper::after { content: ''; display: block; height: 100%; }

        /* ================= MOTION LAYER ================= */
        :root { --ease-out: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(.34, 1.56, .64, 1); }

        /* Page entrance: staggered rise + soft focus-in (translate only, so caret maths stay exact) */
        @keyframes riseIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); filter: blur(8px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: blur(0); } }
        header          { animation: riseIn .9s var(--ease-out) .05s backwards; }
        .config-bar     { animation: riseIn .9s var(--ease-out) .18s backwards; }
        .typing-container { animation: riseIn 1s var(--ease-out) .3s backwards; }
        .footer-controls  { animation: riseIn .9s var(--ease-out) .5s backwards; }
        .bottom-info    { animation: riseIn .9s var(--ease-out) .65s backwards; }

        /* Words flow in whenever a new test loads */
        @keyframes wordIn { from { opacity: 0; filter: blur(6px); } to { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); } }
        .word { animation: wordIn .6s var(--ease-out) backwards; }
.word:nth-child(2){animation-delay:0ms}
        .word:nth-child(3){animation-delay:16ms}
        .word:nth-child(4){animation-delay:32ms}
        .word:nth-child(5){animation-delay:48ms}
        .word:nth-child(6){animation-delay:64ms}
        .word:nth-child(7){animation-delay:80ms}
        .word:nth-child(8){animation-delay:96ms}
        .word:nth-child(9){animation-delay:112ms}
        .word:nth-child(10){animation-delay:128ms}
        .word:nth-child(11){animation-delay:144ms}
        .word:nth-child(12){animation-delay:160ms}
        .word:nth-child(13){animation-delay:176ms}
        .word:nth-child(14){animation-delay:192ms}
        .word:nth-child(15){animation-delay:208ms}
        .word:nth-child(16){animation-delay:224ms}
        .word:nth-child(17){animation-delay:240ms}
        .word:nth-child(18){animation-delay:256ms}
        .word:nth-child(19){animation-delay:272ms}
        .word:nth-child(20){animation-delay:288ms}
        .word:nth-child(21){animation-delay:304ms}
        .word:nth-child(22){animation-delay:320ms}
        .word:nth-child(23){animation-delay:336ms}
        .word:nth-child(24){animation-delay:352ms}
        .word:nth-child(25){animation-delay:368ms}
        .word:nth-child(26){animation-delay:384ms}
        .word:nth-child(27){animation-delay:400ms}
        .word:nth-child(28){animation-delay:416ms}
        .word:nth-child(29){animation-delay:432ms}

        /* Keystroke feedback: correct letters pop, wrong letters shake */
        .letter { display: inline-block; }
        @keyframes popOk { 0% { transform: scale(1); } 40% { transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.18); } 100% { transform: none; } }
        @keyframes shakeBad { 0%, 100% { transform: none; } 20% { transform: translateX(-3px); } 40% { transform: translateX(3px); } 60% { transform: translateX(-2px); } 80% { transform: translateX(1px); } }
        .letter.correct   { animation: popOk .3s var(--ease-spring); }
        .letter.incorrect { animation: shakeBad .34s var(--ease-out); }

        /* Timer, config, buttons */
        @keyframes timerIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-10px) scale(.9); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
        @keyframes warnPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.14); text-shadow: 0 0 26px rgba(255,107,122,.95); } }
        .timer-display.active  { animation: timerIn .5s var(--ease-spring); }
        .timer-display.warning { animation: warnPulse .9s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .config-item { transition: color .25s ease, background .25s ease, transform .25s var(--ease-spring), text-shadow .25s ease; }
        .config-item:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
        .config-item:active { transform: scale(.93); }
        .restart-btn { transition: all .35s var(--ease-out); }
        .restart-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
        .restart-btn:active svg { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(.85); }
        .words-wrapper { transition: opacity .7s var(--ease-out), filter .7s var(--ease-out); }

        /* Results: staggered reveal + breathing glow */
        @keyframes glowBreath { 0%, 100% { text-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--caret-glow); } 50% { text-shadow: 0 0 36px var(--caret-glow), 0 0 62px var(--caret-glow); } }
        .results-screen h2 { animation: riseIn .7s var(--ease-out) .1s backwards; }
        .stat-box { animation: riseIn .9s var(--ease-out) .25s backwards; }
        .stat-box:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .4s; }
        .stat-value { animation: glowBreath 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }

        /* Ambient scene: drifting fireflies + cursor spotlight */
        .fireflies { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: -1; overflow: hidden; }
        .spot { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(460px circle at var(--mx, 50%) var(--my, 40%), rgba(255,244,214,.11), transparent 62%); mix-blend-mode: screen; }
        .fly { position: absolute; left: var(--x); top: var(--y); width: var(--s); height: var(--s); border-radius: 50%; opacity: 0;
               background: radial-gradient(circle, #fffbd0 0%, rgba(255,232,140,.65) 40%, transparent 72%); box-shadow: 0 0 12px 3px rgba(255,228,130,.35);
               animation: flyDrift var(--d) ease-in-out var(--dl) infinite, flyBlink var(--b) ease-in-out var(--dl) infinite; }
        @keyframes flyDrift { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0,0); } 25% { transform: translate(var(--dx), calc(var(--dy) * -.5)); } 50% { transform: translate(calc(var(--dx) * -.6), var(--dy)); } 75% { transform: translate(calc(var(--dx) * .5), calc(var(--dy) * .4)); } }
        @keyframes flyBlink { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0; } 50% { opacity: .9; } }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; } }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <header>
        <div class="logo">typing good</div>
    </header>

    <main>
        <div class="config-bar" id="config-bar">
            <div class="config-group" id="lang-options">
                <div class="config-item lang-opt active" data-lang="en">english</div>
                <div class="config-item lang-opt" data-lang="km">ខ្មែរ khmer</div>
                <div class="config-item lang-opt" data-lang="zh">中文 chinese</div>
            </div>
            <div class="divider"></div>
            <div class="config-group" id="time-options">
                <div class="config-item time-opt active" data-time="15"><svg style="width:12px;height:12px;fill:currentColor;" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M11.99 2C6.47 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.47 10 9.99 10C17.52 22 22 17.52 22 12S17.52 2 11.99 2zM12 20c-4.42 0-8-3.58-8-8s3.58-8 8-8 8 3.58 8 8-3.58 8-8 8zm.5-13H11v6l5.25 3.15.75-1.23-4.5-2.67z"/></svg> 15</div>
                <div class="config-item time-opt" data-time="30">30</div>
                <div class="config-item time-opt" data-time="60">60</div>
                <div class="config-item time-opt" data-time="120">120</div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="typing-container">
            <div class="timer-display" id="timer-display">15</div>
            
            <div class="language-indicator">
                <svg style="width:14px;height:14px;fill:currentColor;" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2C6.48 2 2 6.48 2 12s4.48 10 10 10 10-4.48 10-10S17.52 2 12 2zm-1 17.93c-3.95-.49-7-3.85-7-7.93 0-.62.08-1.21.21-1.79L9 15v1c0 1.1.9 2 2 2v1.93zm6.9-2.54c-.26-.81-1-1.39-1.9-1.39h-1v-3c0-.55-.45-1-1-1H8v-2h2c.55 0 1-.45 1-1V7h2c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2v-.41c2.93 1.19 5 4.06 5 7.41 0 2.08-.8 3.97-2.1 5.39z"/></svg>
                <span id="lang-label">english</span>
            </div>

            <div class="words-wrapper" id="words-wrapper">
                <div class="caret pulse" id="caret"></div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="results-screen" id="results-screen">
                <h2>Test Complete</h2>
                <div class="results-stats">
                    <div class="stat-box">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="wpm-result">0</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">wpm</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="stat-box">
                        <div class="stat-value" id="acc-result">0%</div>
                        <div class="stat-label">acc</div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="focus-warning" id="focus-warning">Click here or press any key to focus</div>

            <button class="restart-btn" id="restart-btn" title="Restart Test (Tab)">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17.65 6.35C16.2 4.9 14.21 4 12 4c-4.42 0-7.99 3.58-7.99 8s3.57 8 7.99 8c3.73 0 6.84-2.55 7.73-6h-2.08c-.82 2.33-3.04 4-5.65 4-3.31 0-6-2.69-6-6s2.69-6 6-6c1.66 0 3.14.69 4.22 1.78L13 11h7V4l-2.35 2.35z"/></svg>
            </button>
        </div>

        <div class="footer-controls">
            <div class="key-hint"><span class="key">tab</span> - restart test</div>
        </div>
    </main>

    <div class="bottom-info">nature theme</div>

    <script>
        const wordsListEn = ["out", "consider", "will", "day", "stand", "think", "state", "around", "be", "good", "develop", "into", "without", "here", "course", "high", "way", "person", "system", "program", "question", "work", "government", "number", "night", "point", "home", "water", "room", "mother", "area", "money", "story", "fact", "month", "lot", "right", "study", "book", "eye", "job", "word"];

        const wordsListZh = ['你好|nihao', '谢谢|xiexie', '再见|zaijian', '中国|zhongguo', '朋友|pengyou', '学习|xuexi', '老师|laoshi', '学生|xuesheng', '学校|xuexiao', '电脑|diannao', '手机|shouji', '工作|gongzuo', '时间|shijian', '今天|jintian', '明天|mingtian', '昨天|zuotian', '早上|zaoshang', '晚上|wanshang', '吃饭|chifan', '喝水|heshui', '睡觉|shuijiao', '喜欢|xihuan', '爱情|aiqing', '家人|jiaren', '家庭|jiating', '高兴|gaoxing', '快乐|kuaile', '漂亮|piaoliang', '好看|haokan', '大学|daxue', '书本|shuben', '音乐|yinyue', '电影|dianying', '城市|chengshi', '国家|guojia', '世界|shijie', '生活|shenghuo', '健康|jiankang', '和平|heping', '自由|ziyou', '未来|weilai', '梦想|mengxiang', '努力|nuli', '成功|chenggong', '问题|wenti', '答案|daan', '汉语|hanyu', '语言|yuyan', '文化|wenhua', '历史|lishi', '天空|tiankong', '太阳|taiyang', '月亮|yueliang', '花园|huayuan', '汽车|qiche', '飞机|feiji', '火车|huoche', '北京|beijing', '上海|shanghai', '我们|women', '你们|nimen', '他们|tamen'];
        const wordsListKm = ["ខ្ញុំ","អ្នក","គាត់","យើង","ស្រឡាញ់","ស្រុក","ខ្មែរ","ភាសា","សៀវភៅ","សាលា","គ្រូ","សិស្ស","មិត្ត","ផ្ទះ","ទឹក","បាយ","ម្ហូប","ត្រី","ស្រូវ","ផ្កា","ដើមឈើ","ថ្ងៃ","ព្រឹក","ល្ងាច","យប់","ស្អែក","សប្បាយ","ស្អាត","ធំ","តូច","ល្អ","ឆាប់","យឺត","រៀន","សរសេរ","អាន","និយាយ","ស្តាប់","ដើរ","រត់","ញ៉ាំ","ផឹក","ដេក","ក្មេង","ចាស់","ប្រទេស","ភ្នំពេញ","កម្ពុជា","អង្គរ","ទន្លេ","ភ្នំ","សមុទ្រ","ផ្លូវ","កុំព្យូទ័រ","ទូរស័ព្ទ","សុខភាព","សេរីភាព","សន្តិភាព","អនាគត","ការងារ","គ្រួសារ","សង្ឃឹម","ចិត្ត","ស្នេហា","ចម្រៀង","សិល្បៈ","វប្បធម៌","ប្រវត្តិ","ពេលវេលា","ជីវិត","ពិភពលោក","អរគុណ","សួស្តី"];

        const wordsWrapper = document.getElementById('words-wrapper');
        const caret = document.getElementById('caret');
        const focusWarning = document.getElementById('focus-warning');
        const restartBtn = document.getElementById('restart-btn');
        const timerDisplay = document.getElementById('timer-display');
        const resultsScreen = document.getElementById('results-screen');
        const configBar = document.getElementById('config-bar');
        const langLabel = document.getElementById('lang-label');

        let lang = 'en';
        let words = [];
        let currentWordIndex = 0;
        let isTyping = false;
        let isTestActive = false;
        let testEnded = false; // true once time is up, until the test is restarted
        let selectedTime = 15;
        let timeLeft = selectedTime;
        let timerInterval = null;
        let correctKeystrokes = 0;
        let totalKeystrokes = 0;

        let caretX = 0, caretY = 0, targetX = 0, targetY = 0;
        const lerpFactor = 0.35;

        // Time-based smoothing: identical glide at 60 / 120 / 144 Hz, with a slight comet-stretch while travelling
        let lastCaretT = performance.now();
        function animateCaret(now) {
            const dt = Math.min(now - lastCaretT, 64); lastCaretT = now;
            const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt / 38);
            const dx = targetX - caretX, dy = targetY - caretY;
            if (Math.abs(dx) < 0.1 && Math.abs(dy) < 0.1) { caretX = targetX; caretY = targetY; }
            else { caretX += dx * k; caretY += dy * k; }
            const stretch = 1 + Math.min(Math.abs(dx), 60) / 60 * 1.2;
            caret.style.transform = `translate3d(${caretX}px, ${caretY}px, 0) scaleX(${stretch.toFixed(3)})`;
            requestAnimationFrame(animateCaret);
        }
        requestAnimationFrame(animateCaret);

        function updateCaretTarget(el) {
            if (!el) return;
            const w = wordsWrapper.getBoundingClientRect(), t = el.getBoundingClientRect();
            targetX = t.left - w.left;
            targetY = t.top - w.top + wordsWrapper.scrollTop;
        }

        // Khmer: group code points into syllable clusters (base + coeng subscripts + vowels/signs)
        function isKhmerCombining(c) {
            const n = c.codePointAt(0);
            return (n >= 0x17B4 && n <= 0x17D3) || n === 0x17DD || n === 0x200C || n === 0x200D;
        }
        function splitUnits(str, khmer) {
            const cps = Array.from(str);
            if (!khmer) return cps.map(c => [c]);
            const units = [];
            cps.forEach((c, i) => {
                const prev = cps[i - 1];
                if (units.length && (isKhmerCombining(c) || (prev && prev.codePointAt(0) === 0x17D2))) units[units.length - 1].push(c);
                else units.push([c]);
            });
            return units;
        }

        function unitIndex(w, n) {
            for (let i = 0; i < w.units.length; i++) if (n >= w.units[i].start && n < w.units[i].start + w.units[i].len) return i;
            return w.units.length;
        }
        function caretTo(w) {
            if (!w) return;
            const i = unitIndex(w, w.typed.length);
            // Keep the caret stuck on line 1: scroll so the line holding the current word is always the top line
            const before = wordsWrapper.scrollTop;
            wordsWrapper.scrollTop = w.el.offsetTop;
            caretY += wordsWrapper.scrollTop - before; // ride along with the text so the caret never slides down a line
            updateCaretTarget(i < w.units.length ? w.units[i].el : w.spaceEl);
        }
        function render(w) {
            w.units.forEach(u => {
                const t = w.typed.slice(u.start, u.start + u.len);
                u.el.classList.remove('correct', 'incorrect', 'partial');
                if (!t.length) return;
                if (t.includes(false)) u.el.classList.add('incorrect');
                else if (t.length === u.len) u.el.classList.add('correct');
                else u.el.classList.add('partial');
            });
        }

        function startTimer() {
            clearInterval(timerInterval);
            isTestActive = true;
            timeLeft = selectedTime;
            timerDisplay.textContent = timeLeft;
            timerDisplay.classList.add('active');
            timerDisplay.classList.remove('warning');
            configBar.style.opacity = '0.3';
            configBar.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
            timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                timeLeft--;
                timerDisplay.textContent = timeLeft;
                if (timeLeft <= 5) timerDisplay.classList.add('warning');
                if (timeLeft <= 0) endTest();
            }, 1000);
        }

        function endTest() {
            if (testEnded) return;
            testEnded = true;
            clearInterval(timerInterval);
            timerInterval = null;
            isTestActive = false;
            isTyping = false;
            caret.style.opacity = '0';
            wordsWrapper.classList.add('finished');
            const wpm = (correctKeystrokes / 5) / (selectedTime / 60);
            const acc = totalKeystrokes > 0 ? Math.round((correctKeystrokes / totalKeystrokes) * 100) : 0;
            document.getElementById('wpm-result').textContent = Math.round(wpm);
            document.getElementById('acc-result').textContent = acc + '%';
            resultsScreen.style.display = 'flex';
        }

        // Show 3 lines at a time; the text scrolls up as you type
        function fitLines() {
            if (!words.length) return;
            const top0 = words[0].el.offsetTop;
            const next = words.find(w => w.el.offsetTop > top0 + 2);
            if (!next) return;
            wordsWrapper._lh = next.el.offsetTop - top0;
            wordsWrapper.style.height = (wordsWrapper._lh * 3) + 'px';
        }

        function initTest() {
            clearInterval(timerInterval);
            wordsWrapper.scrollTop = 0;
            isTyping = false;
            isTestActive = false;
            testEnded = false;
            currentWordIndex = 0;
            correctKeystrokes = 0;
            totalKeystrokes = 0;

            timerDisplay.classList.remove('active', 'warning');
            configBar.style.opacity = '1';
            configBar.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
            resultsScreen.style.display = 'none';
            wordsWrapper.classList.remove('finished');
            caret.style.opacity = '1';
            wordsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.word').forEach(w => w.remove());
            words = [];

            const khmer = lang === 'km';
            const zh = lang === 'zh';
            const list = zh ? wordsListZh : (khmer ? wordsListKm : wordsListEn);
            let pool = [];
            while (pool.length < 400) pool = pool.concat([...list].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()));
            pool.slice(0, 400).forEach((word, index) => {
                const el = document.createElement('div');
                el.className = 'word';
                if (index === 0) el.classList.add('active');
                const [hz, py] = zh ? word.split('|') : [null, word];
                if (hz) { const h = document.createElement('div'); h.className = 'hanzi'; h.textContent = hz; el.appendChild(h); }
                const groups = splitUnits(py, khmer);
                let start = 0;
                const units = groups.map(g => {
                    const span = document.createElement('span');
                    span.className = 'letter';
                    span.textContent = g.join('');
                    el.appendChild(span);
                    const u = { el: span, start, len: g.length };
                    start += g.length;
                    return u;
                });
                const spaceEl = document.createElement('span');
                spaceEl.className = 'letter';
                spaceEl.innerHTML = '&nbsp;';
                el.appendChild(spaceEl);
                wordsWrapper.appendChild(el);
                words.push({ el, units, spaceEl, flat: groups.flat(), typed: [] });
            });

            fitLines();
            const first = words[0] && words[0].units[0];
            if (first) {
                updateCaretTarget(first.el);
                caretX = targetX; caretY = targetY;
                caret.style.transform = `translate3d(${caretX}px, ${caretY}px, 0)`;
            }
        }

        // Characters produced by a keydown (Khmer keys can output several code points); null for named keys
        function typedChars(key) {
            if (key.length === 1) return [key];
            if (/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$/.test(key)) return null;
            return Array.from(key);
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();
            if (e.key === 'Tab' || e.key === 'Backspace') e.preventDefault();
            if (e.key === 'Tab') { initTest(); return; }
            if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.getModifierState('AltGraph')) return;

            const chars = e.key === 'Backspace' ? null : typedChars(e.key);

            if (!isTestActive && !isTyping && !testEnded && chars) {
                isTyping = true;
                focusWarning.style.display = 'none';
                startTimer();
            }
            if (!isTestActive) return;

            const w = words[currentWordIndex];
            if (!w) return;

            if (e.key === 'Backspace') {
                if (w.typed.length) {
                    const ok = w.typed.pop();
                    totalKeystrokes--;
                    if (ok) correctKeystrokes--;
                    render(w); caretTo(w);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (!chars) return;

            if (e.key === ' ') {
                if (w.typed.length < w.flat.length) {
                    // Space pressed mid-word: counts as a wrong character, then move on to the NEXT character (don't skip the word)
                    const u = w.units[unitIndex(w, w.typed.length)];
                    const end = u.start + u.len;
                    while (w.typed.length < end) {
                        w.typed.push(false);
                        totalKeystrokes++;
                    }
                    caret.classList.remove('flash-ok','flash-bad');
                    void caret.offsetWidth;
                    caret.classList.add('flash-bad');
                    clearTimeout(window._flashT);
                    window._flashT = setTimeout(() => caret.classList.remove('flash-ok','flash-bad'), 150);
                    render(w); caretTo(w);
                    return;
                }
                // Word fully typed: space moves to the next word
                totalKeystrokes++; correctKeystrokes++;
                caret.classList.remove('flash-ok','flash-bad');
                void caret.offsetWidth;
                caret.classList.add('flash-ok');
                clearTimeout(window._flashT);
                window._flashT = setTimeout(() => caret.classList.remove('flash-ok','flash-bad'), 150);
                w.el.classList.remove('active');
                currentWordIndex++;
                const next = words[currentWordIndex];
                if (next) { next.el.classList.add('active'); caretTo(next); }
                return;
            }

            chars.forEach(ch => {
                if (w.typed.length >= w.flat.length) return;
                const ok = ch === w.flat[w.typed.length];
                w.typed.push(ok);
                totalKeystrokes++;
                if (ok) correctKeystrokes++;
                caret.classList.remove('flash-ok','flash-bad');
                void caret.offsetWidth;
                caret.classList.add(ok ? 'flash-ok' : 'flash-bad');
                clearTimeout(window._flashT);
                window._flashT = setTimeout(() => caret.classList.remove('flash-ok','flash-bad'), 150);
            });
            render(w); caretTo(w);
        });

        document.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (!isTyping && !isTestActive) focusWarning.style.display = 'none';
        });

        restartBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { restartBtn.blur(); initTest(); });
        // Stop Space/Enter from re-pressing the focused restart button
        restartBtn.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') e.preventDefault(); });
        restartBtn.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') e.preventDefault(); });

        document.querySelectorAll('.time-opt').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (isTestActive) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.time-opt').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
                selectedTime = parseInt(e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-time'));
                initTest();
            });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.lang-opt').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (isTestActive) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.lang-opt').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
                lang = e.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-lang');
                wordsWrapper.classList.toggle('khmer', lang === 'km');
                wordsWrapper.classList.toggle('zh', lang === 'zh');
                langLabel.textContent = {en: 'english', km: 'khmer \u00b7 switch your keyboard to Khmer', zh: 'chinese \u00b7 type the pinyin (no tones)'}[lang];
                initTest();
            });
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => { fitLines(); caretTo(words[currentWordIndex]); caretX = targetX; caretY = targetY; });

        window.onload = () => {
            initTest();
            if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(() => { fitLines(); caretTo(words[currentWordIndex]); });
        };

        // ---- Ambient motion: fireflies, cursor spotlight, animated result counters ----
        (() => {
            const box = document.createElement('div'); box.className = 'fireflies';
            const spot = document.createElement('div'); spot.className = 'spot'; box.appendChild(spot);
            const r = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
            for (let i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                const f = document.createElement('i'); f.className = 'fly';
                f.style.cssText = `--x:${r(2,98)}%;--y:${r(5,95)}%;--s:${r(3,7)}px;--dx:${r(-90,90)}px;--dy:${r(-90,90)}px;--d:${r(14,26)}s;--b:${r(3.5,7)}s;--dl:${-r(0,20)}s`;
                box.appendChild(f);
            }
            document.body.appendChild(box);

            let mx = innerWidth / 2, my = innerHeight * 0.4, sx = mx, sy = my, last = performance.now();
            addEventListener('pointermove', e => { mx = e.clientX; my = e.clientY; }, { passive: true });
            (function loop(t) {
                const k = 1 - Math.exp(-(t - last) / 140); last = t;
                if (Math.abs(mx - sx) > 0.2 || Math.abs(my - sy) > 0.2) {
                    sx += (mx - sx) * k; sy += (my - sy) * k;
                    box.style.setProperty('--mx', sx + 'px'); box.style.setProperty('--my', sy + 'px');
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(loop);
            })(last);

            const rs = document.getElementById('results-screen');
            new MutationObserver(() => {
                if (rs.style.display !== 'flex') return;
                ['wpm-result', 'acc-result'].forEach(id => {
                    const el = document.getElementById(id), end = parseFloat(el.textContent);
                    if (isNaN(end)) return;
                    const suffix = el.textContent.replace(/[\d.]/g, ''), t0 = performance.now();
                    (function step(t) {
                        const p = Math.min((t - t0) / 1100, 1);
                        el.textContent = Math.round(end * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4))) + suffix;
                        if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
                    })(t0);
                });
            }).observe(rs, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style'] });
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
